pages.title: Realm Temperatures
pages.text: These are quality target temperatures, not requirements to start refining. Every weapon and shard recipe accepts any fire. The listed flames are suggestions for reaching the target, not mandatory ingredients.

pages.title: Rule Reference
pages.text: Spirit Transformation / 10,500°C / Violet Firmament Heavenly Flame

pages.title: Rule Reference
pages.text: Void Refinement and Beyond / 12,000°C / Violet Firmament Heavenly Flame

pages.title: Refining Note
pages.text: These temperatures apply to weapon reforging and are determined by the realm of the original weapon, not the cultivator's own realm. Basic weapon recipes have their own target temperatures. Forging does not directly require the player to have reached the weapon's realm.
